meta.title: Alias AI System Architecture & Data-Flow Specification
meta.description: Interactive architectural specification of the Alias AI Zero-Knowledge Privacy Airgap Gateway, detailing component boundaries, enclaves, deterministic and neural sanitization, and sliding-window re-hydration.
meta.author: Alias AI Architectural Working Group
compliance: GDPR Article 25 (Privacy by Design and by Default)
EU AI Act Article 14 (Human Oversight & Technical Governance)

zones.label: Client Applications & IDE Agents
zones.description: Upstream consumer environments generating AI prompts containing code, automotive telematics, database queries, and private credentials.

zones.label: Local Gateway & Reverse Proxy
zones.description: Transparent local HTTP reverse proxy server listening on 127.0.0.1:8080, mimicking standard OpenAI API contract.

zones.label: Local Enclave & Ephemeral Vault
zones.description: Zero-latency entity extraction, deterministic classification, egress firewall invariant verification, and in-memory vault mapping.

zones.label: Workstation Edge Model (Ollama)
zones.description: Local Google Gemma 2 2B neural model running on Ollama for extracting unstructured named entities without cloud telemetry.

zones.label: Untrusted Cloud Reasoning Layer
zones.description: Remote frontier LLM APIs (NVIDIA NIM Nemotron-70B, OpenAI GPT-4o) receiving only structural AST and typed placeholders.

components.label: Cursor / AI Coding IDE
components.description: Autonomous AI coding agent in Cursor IDE. Configured with OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 to transparently route all edits and telematics through the airgap.

components.label: Interactive Terminal REPL
components.description: Minimalist terminal chat REPL inspired by Google Antigravity & Claude Code. Supports real-time token streaming, slash commands (/vault, /rehydrate, /clear, /exit), and instant privacy telemetry.

components.label: Angular Web Dashboard & Docs
components.description: Modern Angular 21 web application providing marketing landing page, interactive privacy playground, compliance documentation, and airgap simulation.

components.label: Python SDK / LangChain / Aider
components.description: Enterprise automated workflows, telemetry analyzers, and agent scripts calling OpenAI/NIM client configured with local base_url.

components.label: Transparent Proxy Server
components.description: High-throughput local HTTP gateway. Manages request lifecycle, routes payloads to the Aliasing Engine, performs cryptographic authentication injection, dispatches outbound TLS requests, and executes sliding-window re-hydration on SSE streams.

components.label: CLI & Setup Wizard
components.description: CLI entry point providing interactive setup wizard, automated preflight diagnostics (doctor), 0.00% leakage verification (test), and environment injection.

components.label: Aliasing Engine Core
components.description: Core entity extraction and pseudonymisation engine. Coordinates deterministic regex parsing, calls optional Gemma 2 local neural extraction, assigns canonical <ALIAS_*> placeholders, and maintains co-reference consistency.

components.label: Ephemeral In-Memory Vault
components.description: Bidirectional in-memory store mapping real sensitive strings to typed alias tokens (e.g. 'DE89370...' <-> '<ALIAS_IBAN_1>'). Never touches disk or swap; purged instantaneously when process exits or /vault command is cleared.

components.label: Egress Gate Firewall
components.description: Hard-fail egress gate checking outbound wire strings against all vault secrets. Enforces E_leak == 0.00%. If any raw secret is detected, aborts connection with zero-byte payload and raises security violation.

components.label: Sliding-Window Re-hydrator
components.description: Stateful sliding-window streaming re-hydrator. Resolves the token-split problem where LLMs fragment <ALIAS_VIN_1> across consecutive SSE packets. Buffers partial alias markers and atomically substitutes real secrets from Vault in real-time.

details.lag: Zero token lag on safe text

components.label: Google Gemma 2 (2B) NER
components.description: Local small language model for neural Named Entity Recognition (NER). Scans prompt text for unstructured executive names, confidential facility code-words, and proprietary project codenames that defy regex patterns.

components.label: NVIDIA NIM Nemotron-70B
components.description: Primary high-reasoning cloud frontier model. Processes anonymized code AST and typed placeholders (<ALIAS_*>) without receiving private credentials, telematics VINs, or bank coordinates.

components.label: OpenAI Cloud API
components.description: Standard cloud upstream fallback. Receives sanitized payload containing immutable placeholders.

connections.label: HTTP POST /v1/chat/completions (Raw Secrets)
connections.description: Cursor dispatches agent queries to local proxy gateway on port 8080.

connections.label: Internal Prompt Stream
connections.description: Interactive CLI chat passes prompt directly to local proxy instance.

connections.label: GET /status & Playground Probes
connections.description: Angular dashboard checks gateway health, active vault size, and runs airgap simulations.

connections.label: sanitizeMessagesAsync()
connections.description: Proxy hands inbound request messages to Aliasing Engine for parsing.

connections.label: Store rawSecret <-> <ALIAS_*>
connections.description: Extracted sensitive values are stored in the Ephemeral Vault, returning deterministic alias tokens.

connections.label: POST /api/generate (Optional Neural NER)
connections.description: When --gemma or --hybrid is enabled, Aliasing Engine queries local Gemma 2 for person names and project codenames.

connections.label: verifyZeroLeakage(outboundText)
connections.description: Egress firewall scans the sanitized payload against every raw secret in Vault to certify 0.00% leakage.

connections.label: Verdict: 0.00% Leakage [PASSED]
connections.description: Firewall clears the outbound payload for cloud transmission.

connections.label: POST /v1/chat/completions (Over TLS)
connections.description: Proxy gateway opens TLS socket to NVIDIA NIM with injected NVIDIA_API_KEY.

connections.label: POST /v1/chat/completions (Fallback)
connections.description: Proxy gateway forwards to OpenAI if selected as upstream provider.

connections.label: Inbound SSE Token Stream
connections.description: Cloud reasoning model streams tokens containing alias tags back to proxy.

connections.label: Pass SSE Chunks (-r active)
connections.description: When re-hydration mode is active, proxy passes incoming chunks to sliding-window buffer.

connections.label: Lookup <ALIAS_*> -> rawSecret
connections.description: Sliding re-hydrator reads real secret values from local reverse vault.

connections.label: Streamed Response to Client
connections.description: Proxy flushes SSE deltas or JSON response to Cursor IDE or calling agent.

traces.name: Standard Airgap Flow (Pass-Through Placeholders)
traces.description: Standard zero-knowledge workflow used by Cursor IDE and coding agents. Raw secrets are replaced with <ALIAS_*> tokens; responses retain placeholders natively.

steps.title: Ingress Request from Cursor Agent
steps.description: Cursor agent sends a prompt containing proprietary automotive telematics: VIN WDB2040011A123456 and DB URI postgresql://admin:secret123@fleet.internal:5432/db.

payloadSample.prompt: Inspect battery sensor telemetry for Mercedes VIN WDB2040011A123456 on postgresql://admin:secret123@fleet.internal:5432/db

steps.title: Deterministic Regex Extraction & Vault Storage
steps.description: Aliasing Engine parses text using 17 regex rules. Real secrets are extracted into the Ephemeral Vault in process RAM.

payloadSample.sanitizedPrompt: Inspect battery sensor telemetry for Mercedes VIN <ALIAS_VIN_1> on <ALIAS_DB_URI_1>

steps.title: Egress Firewall Verification (0.00% Invariant)
steps.description: Egress Firewall iterates all Vault keys and verifies zero substring matches exist in outbound payload. Formula E_leak == 0.00% holds true.

steps.title: Outbound TLS to NVIDIA NIM Nemotron-70B
steps.description: Sanitized wire payload is transmitted to NVIDIA NIM over TLS 1.3 with injected authorization header.

payloadSample.outboundWirePayload: {"model": "meta/llama-3.1-nemotron-70b-instruct", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Inspect battery sensor telemetry for Mercedes VIN <ALIAS_VIN_1> on <ALIAS_DB_URI_1>"}]}

steps.title: Cloud Reasoning & Streaming Response
steps.description: NVIDIA Nemotron-70B reasons on anonymized system structure, returning recommendations referencing <ALIAS_VIN_1> and <ALIAS_DB_URI_1>.

payloadSample.sseChunk: data: {"choices": [{"delta": {"content": "For vehicle <ALIAS_VIN_1>, battery voltage is within normal threshold. Querying database <ALIAS_DB_URI_1> for historical trends..."}}]}

steps.title: Pass-Through SSE Stream to Agent
steps.description: Proxy pipes SSE stream straight to Cursor IDE with 0ms added latency. Agent treats <ALIAS_*> as immutable semantic variables.

payloadSample.clientOutput: For vehicle <ALIAS_VIN_1>, battery voltage is within normal threshold. Querying database <ALIAS_DB_URI_1> for historical trends...

traces.name: Sliding-Window Re-hydration Flow (`alias-ai start -r`)
traces.description: Solves token-split boundary fragmentation when streaming SSE tokens from cloud LLMs, restoring real secrets inside local workstation memory.

steps.title: Client Ingress with Warranty Payout Details
steps.description: User submits a prompt with a German IBAN: DE89370400440532013000 to initiate warranty reimbursement.

payloadSample.prompt: Disburse warranty payment of €1,450 to German IBAN DE89370400440532013000.

steps.title: Vault Ingestion & Placeholder Mapping
steps.description: IBAN is mapped to <ALIAS_IBAN_1> in both forward vault and reverseVault.

steps.title: Cloud Inference Streams Fragmented Tokens
steps.description: NVIDIA NIM streams tokens. Tokenizer splits alias into: Chunk 1 ('Transfer authorized to <ALIAS_I'), Chunk 2 ('BAN_'), Chunk 3 ('1>.').

steps.title: Sliding-Window Stateful Reassembly & Reverse Lookup
steps.description: Sliding-window buffer buffers partial tag prefix. On closure tag '>', triggers atomic reverse lookup from Ephemeral Vault.

steps.title: Restored Plaintext Delivered to Client
steps.description: Terminal chat receives fully reconstructed text containing real IBAN without the cloud ever having seen it.

traces.name: Hybrid Sanitization with Local Gemma 2 NER (`--gemma`)
traces.description: Uses on-device Google Gemma 2 (2B) on Ollama to identify unstructured named entities (executive names, project codenames, secret facilities).

steps.title: Unstructured Prompt Ingestion
steps.description: User prompt contains unstructured personal names and project codenames: 'Lead engineer Dr. Florian Mueller requested review of Project Starlight at Stuttgart Proving Grounds.'

steps.title: Local Query to Google Gemma 2 on Ollama
steps.description: Aliasing Engine sends structured JSON extraction prompt to 127.0.0.1:11434 with model gemma2:2b.

payloadSample.ollamaPrompt: Extract confidential person names, internal facilities, or secret project codenames from this text: ...

steps.title: Neural Vault Mapping & Outbound Dispatch
steps.description: Entities mapped to <ALIAS_ENTITY_1>, <ALIAS_ENTITY_2>, <ALIAS_ENTITY_3>. Pure semantic structure forwarded to NVIDIA NIM.

payloadSample.sanitizedWire: Lead engineer <ALIAS_ENTITY_1> requested review of <ALIAS_ENTITY_2> at <ALIAS_ENTITY_3>.

traces.name: System Health & Doctor Audit (`alias-ai doctor`)
traces.description: Performs preflight checks on Node.js >= 18, port availability, Ollama/Gemma 2 service, regex throughput benchmarks, and audit attestation.

steps.title: CLI Controller Triggers Doctor Command
steps.description: Operator runs 'alias-ai doctor' or hits GET /status to inspect gateway telemetry.

steps.title: Throughput Benchmark Execution
steps.description: Benchmarks 500 enterprise prompts with multi-category secrets. Confirms sub-millisecond execution (<0.03ms per prompt).

steps.title: Cryptographic Audit Attestation Emission
steps.description: Emits JSON status containing SHA-256 integrity hash confirming GDPR Article 25 and EU AI Act Article 14 compliance.

privacyLadder.name: Local Disk / RAM
privacyLadder.content: Raw source code + plaintext secrets (VINs, IBANs, API keys)
privacyLadder.enforcement: Secrets never leave workstation volatile memory.

privacyLadder.name: Local Sanitizer Enclave
privacyLadder.enforcement: 17 deterministic regex rules + optional local Gemma 2 (2B) NER store secrets in RAM vault.

privacyLadder.name: Egress Gate Firewall
privacyLadder.enforcement: Mathematical invariant E_leak == 0.00% proven against vault before outbound TLS.

privacyLadder.name: Cloud Frontier Reasoning LLM
privacyLadder.enforcement: NVIDIA Nemotron-70B or OpenAI reasons on structure without seeing real credentials.

privacyLadder.name: Inbound Stream / Local Client
privacyLadder.enforcement: Default: Pass-through with placeholders intact. Optional (-r): Local sliding-window re-hydration.
